sources.summary: The project is situated in Emmenbrücke, a town just outside Lucerne. Set within an industrial and high-traffic environment, the building marks the start of the row of houses by Emmenbrücke railway station. Nestled between the railway tracks and the main road, the ground floor houses a petrol station, while the six stories above provide residential apartments.
